name: Record-held answers reached and followed
purpose: Where the right answer to a request depends on a record the consumer's network holds, that record reaches the pass of the solution it belongs to and the pass's verdict follows it.
record: Per arm and knowledge mode (retrieved, all, none), the share of flow cases (evaluation/solution_passes) whose deciding record is in a considered solution's prompt (free) and whose pass cites it and reaches the expected verdict (real), with calls per case.
disadvantages: The cases are written on the hub's own public records; a consumer's records may hold the deciding fact in a shape no case has.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=a change to the arm, the briefs or the records] > one [sample=sample:1 | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the free stage passes every case: one case with the cheap tier] > all [sample=full | real=yes | gate=competitive | when=the one case passes: every case with the cheap tier]
